title: An Empirical Study on Distribution Shift Robustness From the Perspective of Pre-Training and Data Augmentation
reasoning: The paper discusses 'fair machine learning' and 'spurious correlation' which have ethical implications, but its primary focus is on empirical evaluation of technical methods (pre-training, data augmentation) to improve robustness to distribution shifts, not on evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics themselves. The ethical dimension is a context for the technical problem rather than the object of study.
